_comment: Retailer overlay card: requirements a specific customer imposes on its supply partners beyond the FDA rule. Overlays are reviewable data, not code - add kroger/albertsons cards here without any code change. Source: Walmart's public FSMA 204 supplier instructions (shared by ENSESO4Food, 2026-07-03 call).

citation.support_text: Walmart instructs supply partners to use GS1 formats (GTIN product identifiers, GLN location identifiers) for FSMA 204 traceability data.
